associations.event: Catt replaces Ram as CO; Ram becomes XO
associations.originalReading:
8 SEPTEMBER 1965                  Captain C. H. RAM was relieved as Commanding
                                  Officer by Major J. R. CATT.  Captain C. H. RAM
                                  became the Executive Officer.

associations.originalReading:
16 SEPTEMBER 1965                 SEATO DEMONSTRATION

                                  representatives of the Southeast Asia Treaty
                                  Organization.  The Battalion was the ground maneuver
                                  element.
